headline: Vivek Biyani files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations for Praxis Home Retail
sum: Vivek Biyani has filed a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, signalling a material change in shareholding or control intent in Praxis Home Retail Limited.
detail: Vivek Biyani submitted the disclosure to NSE as per SEBI Takeover Regulations. The filing is a Regulation 31(4) disclosure, which is typically required when a person acquires or proposes to acquire shares in a listed company such that the acquirer would hold 25% or more of the voting rights, or would change control. The specific shareholding quantity and acquisition structure are contained in the filed disclosure document. This filing is a mandatory step in any substantial acquisition framework and does not by itself indicate completion but rather the formal notice of intent or ongoing acquisition.
